page.layout: One column of running text. Margin notes in the left margin, beside lines 1 to 27. Running head at top, page number at top left. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: aindeptusreperi, novem. Demetrius regnum {a}ade-Par. Demetri- us rex.ptus, Ionathan benigne habuit, foedus cū eo fecit, Iudæos legibus suis reddidit. In-b qui Di- odotus Strabo. etterea {b}Tryphon, qui partium Alexandri fuerat, præfectus Syriæ regno. eum[?] bello prohibiturus, contra Ionathā in præliumAppiano. 1. Mac. 11. & seq. c. descendit, terribilis x l.[?] millium exercitu. Mach. 12.[?]Tryphōn, ubi se imparem cernit, pacem simulat: receptumq; in amicitiam, invita-tumq; Ptolemaidam, interfecit. Post Io-nathan, summa rerum ad Simonem fra-trem defertur. Is funus fratris magnifice Simon fac. & dux. 1. Mac. 13.curavit: septemque illas pyramidas nobi-lissimi operis exstruxit, in quibus & fra-trum & patris ossa condidit. Tum Deme-trius, refecto cum Iudæis fœdere, con-templatione cladis a Tryphone illatæ (nam post Ionathæ necem urbes eorum atque agros bello vastaverat) annua {b}ejusbeis. Gisc[?] vectigalia in perpetuum remittit. Etenim usq; ad id tempus, regibus Syriæ, nisi cum armis resisterent, stipendium pensitave-rant. Id gestum Demetrii regis anno {c}se-c qui fuit primus Simoniscundo. quod ideo signavimus, quia us-ethnarchæque in hunc annum per tempora Asia-norum regum cucurrimus, ut ratio tem-170. regni Sy-riæ. 1oporum digesta luceret. Nunc autem per seph l 13 c. 1. 1[?]tempora

page.notes: Printing is clear overall. Doubtful readings: "eum" (line 5) may be "cum"; "x l." (line 7) is an uncertain numeral; "Mach. 12." and "beis. Gisc" in the margin are hard to read; "seph l" and "13 c. 1. 1" in the lower margin are uncertain. The margin notes are small and partly broken. The word "ade-" at the end of line 1 continues as "ptus" on line 2 after a printed mark, read here as a hyphen. The left-margin notes are the only marginalia; no right-margin text was found.
